paragraphs.text: Many people start running with great enthusiasm but give up within a few weeks, often because they try to do too much too soon. Experts recommend beginning with a mix of walking and running rather than running continuously.

A typical beginner plan lasts nine weeks. In the first week, runners alternate one minute of jogging with ninety seconds of walking for twenty minutes, three times a week. The running periods gradually become longer until the runner can jog for thirty minutes without stopping.
Rest days are an important part of the plan, because muscles and joints need time to adapt. Beginners who run every day are more likely to suffer injuries, particularly to the knees and shins.
Good shoes matter more than expensive clothing. Many sports shops will watch customers run on a treadmill and recommend shoes that suit the way they move.
Running with a friend or joining a local group can also make it easier to keep going on days when motivation is low.

items.quote: they try to do too much too soon

explanation.en: “they try to do too much too soon” → soon. The summary repeats the fixed phrase.
explanation.kk: «they try to do too much too soon» → soon. Түйін «too much too soon» тіркесін қайталайды.
explanation.ru: «they try to do too much too soon» → soon. Пересказ повторяет устойчивую фразу «too much too soon».

items.quote: beginning with a mix of walking and running

explanation.en: Beginners are advised to use “a mix of walking and running”. “Combine running with” means the same, so the answer is walking.
explanation.kk: Жаңадан бастағандарға «a mix of walking and running» ұсынылады. Түйіндегі «combine running with» — осының өзі, жауап walking.
explanation.ru: Новичкам советуют «a mix of walking and running». «Combine running with» в пересказе значит то же самое, ответ walking.

items.quote: A typical beginner plan lasts nine weeks

explanation.en: “A typical beginner plan lasts nine weeks” → weeks. The minutes and seconds next are interval lengths, not the plan.
explanation.kk: «A typical beginner plan lasts nine weeks» → weeks. Келесі сөйлемдегі минут пен секунд — жоспардың емес, бөліктердің ұзақтығы.
explanation.ru: «A typical beginner plan lasts nine weeks» → weeks. Минуты и секунды в следующем предложении — длина отрезков, а не плана.

items.quote: Beginners who run every day are more likely to suffer injuries

explanation.en: Without rest beginners are “more likely to suffer injuries” → injuries, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: Демалыссыз жаңадан бастағандар жиі «injuries» алады → injuries, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: Без отдыха новички чаще получают «injuries» → injuries, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: Many sports shops will watch customers run on a treadmill

explanation.en: “watch customers run on a treadmill” → treadmill. “Clothing” in the same paragraph matters less than shoes.
explanation.kk: «watch customers run on a treadmill» → treadmill. Сол абзацтағы «clothing» — аяқкиімнен маңызды емес нәрсе.
explanation.ru: «watch customers run on a treadmill» → treadmill. «Clothing» в том же абзаце — то, что важнее обуви не является.
